faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions & Transparency
faq.subheading: Clear and direct answers regarding the platform model, digital access, and draw integrity
faq.q_model_1: Why does KNZiN grant free promotional tickets with courses?
faq.a_model_1: KNZiN operates a lawful promotional model aimed at encouraging youth to master vocational skills. Tickets are complimentary gifts attached to educational digital content and can never be purchased independently.
faq.q_model_2: Can I purchase a raffle ticket without purchasing a course?
faq.a_model_2: No, standalone ticket purchases are strictly prohibited. KNZiN is a commercial vocational learning platform; promotional tickets are complimentary gifts awarded automatically with each educational part.
faq.q_downloads_1: How and when do I access the educational material after checkout?
faq.a_downloads_1: Access is granted immediately upon confirmed payment through your account, where you can stream videos and download practical PDF workbooks with permanent lifetime access.
faq.q_draws_1: How do you guarantee draw fairness and prevent tampering?
faq.a_draws_1: The platform relies on published cryptographic seed hashes with draws streamed live on our official YouTube channel, where winning numbers and winners are announced openly.
faq.q_referral_1: How does the 40% co-prize affiliate system work?
faq.a_referral_1: When you share your referral link and an invited friend enrolls in a course whose free ticket wins any major prize, you as the referring partner earn a bonus equivalent to 40% of the prize amount.
faq.q_kyc_1: What documents are required to claim cash or grand prizes?
faq.a_kyc_1: The winner is strictly required to present official national identification (Unified National Card or Passport) matching the primary email used during checkout to ensure lawful prize distribution.
